info.title: Haven't You Heard? I'm Sakamoto
info.synopsis: Sakamoto è uno studente al primo anno delle superiori che oltre ad essere ben noto e popolare, è ritenuto da tutti un "figo". Che si tratti di aiutare il prossimo, difendere i deboli dai bulli o evitare le trappole degli invidiosi compagni di scuola, Sakamoto riesce sempre a risolvere il problema, con assoluta classe ed eleganza.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Sakamoto is a stylish student whose cool behavior draws the attention of everyone at his high school. Three punks in his class who don't like him, Acchan, Mario, and Kenken, target him for all sorts of bullying, but it always backfires on them. So they finally decide to take care of him for real...

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis:
One day, Sakamoto sees his classmate, Kubota, being shaken down for money. He calls out to him, and Kubota begs for his help, saying he has no money left. But Sakamoto has an idea...

Who's the coolest? Sakamoto. Girls compete for him and play Kokkuri-San to find out who he likes. How will it end up?
